title: Impression Basis Breakdown Entry
description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). The plays of a DOOH row, or of a forecast point, whose audience was estimated on one tier, and the impressions they produced. A row that aggregates plays estimated on different tiers (sensor-equipped screens and screens without a sensor, or one screen whose sensor stopped reporting for part of the flight) lists one entry per tier instead of a row-level `impression_basis`: at least two entries, at most one per tier. In a delivery row the entries' `plays` and `impressions` sum exactly to the row's `plays` and `impressions`; in a forecast point they are the expected values behind the point's midpoints. Entries of different tiers are different units with no exchange rate.

impression_basis.description: Tier the audience of these plays was estimated on.

plays.description: Plays whose audience was estimated on this tier.

impressions.description: Impressions those plays produced: their plays × their audience multiplier.

audience_multiplier.description: Effective `impressions / plays` of these plays, declared rather than inferred. Optional on `currency_measured` entries when the currency's terms prohibit disclosing it.
